issues.description: The template's commented example in Main.java calls farm.feed(), but the problem specification and solution expect a method named feedAllAnimals(). This name/signature mismatch between the template sample and the specified API can confuse students about which method to implement or call.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template's example use the same method name as specified (call farm.feedAllAnimals() in the commented example), or add a feed() delegating method in Farm that calls feedAllAnimals() to provide the alternative name. This ensures consistency between the template, problem statement, and solution.

issues.description: The problem statement and solution name the action to feed every animal as feedAllAnimals(), but the template's Main.java uses farm.feed() (a different identifier for the same concept). This mismatch can confuse students searching the template for the method referenced in the specification and cause them to look for or implement the wrong method name.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template consistent with the problem statement and solution by changing the call 'farm.feed()' in template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java to 'farm.feedAllAnimals()' (or add a feed() method that delegates to feedAllAnimals()).
